A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 92-page versions of SpatiaLab, with readable text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–K. All appendix pages match in extracted text and rendering.

before.justification: v1 reports original VLM and human evaluations in Tables 2–3, prompting and fine-tuning experiments in Appendix H, and statistical robustness results in Appendix K.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark evaluations, intervention experiments, and statistical analyses, including their numerical results.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, prompting strategies, LoRA fine-tuning, and SpatioXolver pipeline remain unchanged. Adding SpatioXolver's name to the contribution list and subsection heading does not introduce a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six-category, 30-subcategory SpatiaLab benchmark in MCQ and open-ended formats. Appendix H.4.4 retains OmniSpatial, SPACE (Multimodal), and Mind the Gap. Figure 2's illustrative replacement does not establish changed evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–3 and the corresponding appendix experiments, including human baselines and comparisons involving prompting, fine-tuning, and agents.

E3.justification: Accuracy metrics, automatic judging, generation settings, the 40%/60% fine-tuning split, and the 150-item prompting and agent evaluation subsets are unchanged. No revised experimental protocol is reported.

E4.justification: The error analyses, prompting comparisons, SFT dynamics, transfer evaluations, agent diagnostics, qualitative cases, and robustness studies are retained unchanged. Figure 2 revises illustrative benchmark examples without adding an analysis or model outcome.

E5.justification: Both versions contain the same five-seed SFT study, three-run robustness evaluations, standard deviations, reliability estimates, and 1,000-trial resampling analysis with Wilcoxon tests.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Tables 2–3 retain InternVL3.5-72B's 54.93% MCQ accuracy and GPT-5-mini's 40.93% open-ended accuracy. Removing a repeated performance summary from Section 6 does not remove the underlying findings.

T1.justification: The scene-to-relation formulation in Section 2 and mathematical definitions in Appendices D and K are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The benchmark contribution, human–model performance gap, open-ended difficulty, and limitations of reasoning interventions retain the same scope. Explicitly naming the existing SpatioXolver system does not expand the contribution.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning perceptual grounding, fine-tuning instability, and reasoning-induced error amplification remain unchanged. Section 6 loses a redundant performance recap, while its explanations and qualifications are preserved.

D1.justification: Evaluation prompts, training hyperparameters, agent implementation details, and project-access information are unchanged. The new correspondence line and acknowledgments add contact and credit information without new technical settings or resource-access instructions.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, benchmark positioning, and attribution of SpatioXolver to Xolver are unchanged. References reflow across pages without changes to their content.

P1.justification: v3 adds correspondence information and acknowledgments, explicitly names SpatioXolver in two existing passages, removes a repetitive sentence from Section 6, and edits example wording. The document's narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 replaces the woman/object positioning example with a walkway-counting image, question, options, and answer, while retaining the Relative Positioning label. It also clarifies the ambulance question. Front-matter spacing and subsequent pagination change; tables and appendix displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Scientific evidence and reproducibility remain unchanged. Although v3 clarifies the ambulance example and makes small editorial improvements, Figure 2 replaces a relative-position question with a navigation-loop question under the unchanged Relative Positioning label. This introduces a localized inconsistency with the taxonomy in Appendix B, slightly weakening the accuracy of the benchmark illustration.
